# Configuration reference

Every key of the configuration file. See [the guide](./configuration.md)
for how the keys work together.

## ProjectConfig

A QGIS Project Configurator configuration file.

Any value can be replaced with `!include <path>` to read it from another
YAML file. The path is relative to the including file.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data_sources` | mapping of [PostgisSourceConfig](#postgissourceconfig) or [GpkgSourceConfig](#gpkgsourceconfig) | yes | Data sources by name. The data source to use is selected when creating the project. |
| `product_versions` | list of string | no | Product version names. Used to select styles with `style_overrides`. |
| `layer_tree` | list of [LayerTreeNode](#layertreenode) | no | Layers and groups of the project, from top to bottom. |
| `project_properties` | [ProjectProperties](#projectproperties) | no | Values written to the project with `QgsProject.writeEntry`, and the CRS. |
| `layouts` | list of [LayoutConfig](#layoutconfig) | no | Print layouts to add to the project. |
| `metadata` | mapping | no | Free-form metadata. Read with `qpc get-metadata`. |

## PostgisSourceConfig

A PostGIS database connection.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `postgis` | yes | Data source type. |
| `service` | string | yes | Name of the PostgreSQL connection service (pg_service.conf). |
| `schema` | string | yes | Database schema of the tables. |
| `geom_column` | string | yes | Name of the geometry column. |
| `table` | string or null | no | Table name for every layer. It replaces the layer's own `table`. Usually left out or null, and each layer sets its `table`. |

## GpkgSourceConfig

A GeoPackage file.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `gpkg` | yes | Data source type. |
| `path` | string | yes | Path to the .gpkg file, relative to the config file. |
| `table` | string or null | no | Table name for every layer. It replaces the layer's own `table`. Usually left out or null, and each layer sets its `table`. |

## LayerTreeNode

A layer tree item.

The key `group`, `vector_layer` or `embedded_group` sets its kind.

Type: [GroupNode](#groupnode) or [VectorLayerNode](#vectorlayernode) or [EmbeddedGroupNode](#embeddedgroupnode)

## GroupNode

A layer group in the layer tree.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | string | yes | Group name. Groups with no layers left are not added to the project. |
| `children` | list of [LayerTreeNode](#layertreenode) | no | Layers and groups inside this group. |
| `defaults` | [VectorLayerSettings](#vectorlayersettings) | no | Settings for all layers inside this group, also in sub groups. Merged with the defaults of parent groups. Nested mappings merge, lists and other values replace. A layer's own settings win. |

## VectorLayerSettings

Vector layer settings. Allowed on a layer and in group `defaults`.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `style` | string | no | Path to a .qml style file, relative to the config file. Use `hidden` to leave the layer out of the project. |
| `style_overrides` | mapping of string | no | Style per product version: product version name to .qml path or `hidden`. Wins over `style` when that product version is selected. |
| `table` | string | no | Table name in the selected data source. |
| `scale` | [ScaleConfig](#scaleconfig) | no | Scale based visibility. |
| `data_source_overrides` | mapping of [DataSourceOverride](#datasourceoverride) | no | Data source settings per data source name. Merged over `data_sources`. |
| `map_themes` | list of string | no | Names of the map themes where the layer is visible. |

## ScaleConfig

Scale range where the layer is visible.

Values are scale denominators (1000 means 1:1000). Null or 0 means no limit.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min` | number or null | no | Most zoomed out scale where the layer is visible (e.g. 3000000). |
| `max` | number or null | no | Most zoomed in scale where the layer is visible (e.g. 500000). |

## DataSourceOverride

Data source settings for one layer or group.

Merged over the data source with the same name in `data_sources`,
so only the changed keys are needed.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `postgis` or `gpkg` | no | Data source type. |
| `service` | string | no | Name of the PostgreSQL connection service (pg_service.conf). |
| `schema` | string | no | Database schema of the table. |
| `geom_column` | string | no | Name of the geometry column. |
| `path` | string | no | Path to the .gpkg file, relative to the config file. |
| `table` | string or null | no | Table name. Wins over the layer's `table`. |

## VectorLayerNode

A vector layer in the layer tree.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vector_layer` | string | yes | Layer name. |
| `style` | string | no | Path to a .qml style file, relative to the config file. Use `hidden` to leave the layer out of the project. |
| `style_overrides` | mapping of string | no | Style per product version: product version name to .qml path or `hidden`. Wins over `style` when that product version is selected. |
| `table` | string | no | Table name in the selected data source. |
| `scale` | [ScaleConfig](#scaleconfig) | no | Scale based visibility. |
| `data_source_overrides` | mapping of [DataSourceOverride](#datasourceoverride) | no | Data source settings per data source name. Merged over `data_sources`. |
| `map_themes` | list of string | no | Names of the map themes where the layer is visible. |

## EmbeddedGroupNode

A layer group embedded from another QGIS project.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `embedded_group` | string | yes | Name of the group in the source project. |
| `source` | string | yes | Path to the source QGIS project, relative to the created project's folder. |

## ProjectProperties

Project properties: the first key is the scope, nested keys form the key path.

Every key other than `crs` is a scope.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `crs` | integer | no | EPSG code of the project CRS (e.g. 3067). Sets the CRS, not a property. |

Other keys: [ProjectPropertyValue](#projectpropertyvalue)

## ProjectPropertyValue

A project property value, or a mapping of nested keys.

Nested keys are joined with `/`: `A: { B: { C: 1 } }` writes key `B/C`
in scope `A`. A value directly under the scope is written to key `/`.

Type: boolean or integer or string or list of string or mapping of [ProjectPropertyValue](#projectpropertyvalue)

## LayoutConfig

A print layout.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layout_file` | string | yes | Path to a .qpt layout template, relative to the config file. |
| `atlas_coverage_layer` | string | no | Name of the layer to use as the atlas coverage layer. |
